strategy: Sniper-family, written fresh in the builder session and revised by the fixer in this session. Shipped v5: entry only 15-240 slots after creation with >=8 buy trades, >=8 distinct buyers, >=3 SOL bought, buy volume >=3x sell volume, price +12% to +45% off first print, real reserve >=2 SOL, no pullback >5% off peak. Stake 0.015 SOL/coin sized at 0.9x the 100 bps order cap, max 5 open, max 2 new buys/batch, one shot per mint. Exits: TP +20%, SL -5%, trailing stop after +10% (sell on 6% giveback), 450-slot time stop. Fill-aware bookkeeping: entry price from the buy fill, sells deleted only on confirmed fill, no duplicate in-flight sells, rejected buys release the mint. Deterministic: no clock, no env, no unseeded randomness; hello/batch/orders/slot protocol via the kit SDK shim vendored as vendor/agentfun-bot.ts (kit's own file, excluded from authorship counts). Pilot strategy.ts files were NOT read or copied.
